title: Boss: the customer export
summary: Clean a realistic messy export end to end: names, types, duplicates, gaps and checks.

steps.title: The export
body: Marketing sent a customer export. It has every problem from this module: odd column names, padded text, prices with `$`, dates as text, duplicate customers, gaps and a few impossible values. Each step below adds one piece; the last step chains them into a pipeline.

steps.title: The pipeline
prompt: Your `load`, `clean` and `dedupe` are in the editor. Write `pipeline(text)` returning a tuple `(df, problems)`:
2. `problems` is a list of messages, in this order, for checks that fail on the final `df`:
- `"duplicate customer_id"` if ids are not unique,
- `"N missing signup_date"` if any signup dates are missing (N is the count),
- `"unknown city"` if any city is not one of `"London"`, `"Paris"`, `"Rome"`.
steps.starter:
import io
import pandas as pd


def load(text):
    df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(text), skipinitialspace=True)
    df.columns = df.columns.str.strip().str.lower().str.replace(" ", "_")
    return df


def clean(df):
    out = df.copy()
    for col in ["name", "city"]:
        out[col] = out[col].str.strip().str.title()
    out["signup_date"] = pd.to_datetime(out["signup_date"], format="%d/%m/%Y", errors="coerce")
    spend = pd.to_numeric(out["total_spend"].str.replace(r"[$,]", "", regex=True), errors="coerce")
    out["total_spend"] = spend.where(spend >= 0)
    return out


def dedupe(df):
    out = (df.sort_values("signup_date", na_position="first")
             .drop_duplicates(subset="customer_id", keep="last"))
    out = out.fillna({"total_spend": out["total_spend"].median()})
    return out.sort_values("customer_id").reset_index(drop=True)
